qualified_propositions.proposition_text: All catches below the applicable minimum conservation reference size retained on board a United Kingdom fishing vessel shall be placed in boxes, compartments or containers in such a way that they are identifiable from other boxes, compartments or containers.
Those catches shall not be mixed with any other fishery products.

Paragraph 1 of Article 49a shall not apply where the catches contain more than 80% of one or more small pelagic species, namely mackerel, herring, horse mackerel, blue whiting, boarfish, anchovy, argentine, sardine, or sprat.
Article 49a(1) shall not apply where the catches contain more than 80% of one or more species used for industrial purposes, namely capelin, sandeel, or Norwegian pout.

Paragraph 1 of Article 49a shall not apply to fishing vessels of less than 12 metres' length overall where catches below the minimum conservation reference size have been sorted, estimated and recorded in accordance with Article 14 of the Regulation.
In the cases referred to in Article 49a(2), a fisheries administration must monitor the catch composition by way of sampling.

negative_cases.proposition_text: Masters shall keep records in accordance with Article 14.
Paragraph 1 of Article 99 shall not apply to experimental fisheries.
